title: FAQ
summary: A self-service question and answer list for your customers, embeddable on your own site.
html:
The FAQ area holds questions and answers for your customers. It exists to reduce the number of tickets you answer twice.

Writing entries

Each entry is a question and an answer. Write the question the way a customer would ask it, not the way you would describe the feature — people search with their own words.

Where customers see it

  • In the portal, alongside their records.
  • While raising a ticket. As they type, matching entries are offered. This is where it saves the most work.
  • Embedded on your own website, with the code from Settings → FAQ.

Linking entries to products

An FAQ entry can be attached to one or more products, so a customer asking about a particular product is shown the questions that relate to it rather than the whole list.

Keeping it useful

The best source of new entries is your own ticket queue. When you answer the same question a third time, write it up here and link the ticket to it. An FAQ nobody adds to stops matching how the product actually works within a year.
